2607.16868.title: Beyond Semantic Equivalence: Logical Graphs for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
2607.16868.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce confidently stated yet unreliable outputs, posing critical challenges for deployment in safety-sensitive applications. Existing uncertainty metrics such as semantic entropy capture agreement at the level of semantic equivalence, but largely ignore the logical relationships between distinct answers. As a result, they tend to overestimate uncertainty and falsely flag hallucinations in settings where generated responses are diverse in form yet logically compatible (e.g., differing only in granularity or specificity). We propose Logical Graph Uncertainty (LGU), a framework that explicitly models implication and incompatibility among answers. LGU aggregates probability mass along entailment chains, computes entropy over logically maximal hypotheses, and penalizes mutual incompatibility among them. Across multiple question-answering benchmarks, LGU consistently improves uncertainty estimation over existing methods, and outperforms the semantic entropy baseline by up to +7.1% AUROC and +3.5% AUARC across datasets.
2607.16868.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）經常產生自信但不可靠的輸出，對於在安全敏感應用中的部署構成了重大挑戰。現有的不確定性度量，如語義熵，捕捉到語義等價層面的共識，但在很大程度上忽略了不同答案之間的邏輯關係。因此，它們往往高估不確定性，並在生成的回應形式多樣但邏輯上相容的情況下錯誤標記幻覺（例如，僅在粒度或具體性上有所不同）。我們提出了邏輯圖不確定性（LGU），這是一個明確建模答案之間的蕴含和不相容性的框架。LGU 沿著蕴含鏈聚合概率質量，計算邏輯最大假設的熵，並懲罰它們之間的相互不相容性。在多個問答基準中，LGU 一貫改善了現有方法的不確定性估計，並在各數據集上超越語義熵基準高達 +7.1% AUROC 和 +3.5% AUARC。
